grid: Each atlas is square, four columns by four rows, row-major order, sixteen unique centered portraits, no lettering or borders.

cells.name: Cave Bat
cells.brief: A small leathery cave bat, broad membranous wings, large pointed ears, tiny amber eyes; unmistakably a bat.

cells.name: Goblin Scout
cells.brief: Lean green goblin scout with long pointed ears, ragged leather hood and chipped short blade.

cells.name: Ember Slime
cells.brief: Rounded translucent orange-red slime, molten ember core and soot bubbles; soft gelatinous body.

cells.name: Shadow Imp
cells.brief: Small violet horned imp with narrow grin, wispy shadow wings and long curling tail.

cells.name: Crystal Spider
cells.brief: Eight-legged spider with jagged translucent quartz limbs and a faceted crystal abdomen.

cells.name: Ember Rat
cells.brief: A soot-black rat with long bare tail, whiskers, ember-red eyes and glowing scorched fur tips.

cells.name: Tunnel Kobold
cells.brief: Small copper-scaled reptilian kobold, long snout, miner headlamp and curved mining knife.

cells.name: Cave Lizard
cells.brief: Low slate-blue lizard with four splayed legs, ridged back, long tail and luminous throat.

cells.name: Mossback Toad
cells.brief: Squat broad toad with bulging eyes and thick living moss on a wart-covered green back.

cells.name: Lantern Moth
cells.brief: Delicate moth with feathery antennae, broad patterned cream wings and a warm lantern-glowing abdomen.

cells.name: Goblin Brute
cells.brief: Stocky muscular goblin with heavy jaw, oversized shoulder armor and a crude leg-bone club.

cells.name: Cave Crab
cells.brief: Broad stone-shelled cave crab with two huge pincers, eyestalks and clearly visible segmented legs.

cells.name: Ember Pup
cells.brief: Young wolf-like hound with alert ears, charcoal fur, glowing orange chest and ember breath.

cells.name: Dust Wisp
cells.brief: Tiny airy spirit formed from pale sand and dust, swirling ribbon body and two pinprick eyes.

cells.name: Feral Imp
cells.brief: Wild red horned imp, shaggy mane, outsized claws and teeth, crouched animal posture.

cells.name: Bone Husk
cells.brief: Fragile hunched skeletal minion made of mismatched bones, exposed rib cage and dim skull glow; no armor.

cells.name: Skeleton Warrior
cells.brief: Upright skeleton soldier in rusted helmet and partial iron armor, carrying a chipped sword.

cells.name: Rune Wraith
cells.brief: Floating blue-violet hooded specter with hollow face and luminous runes orbiting ragged robes.

cells.name: Frost Revenant
cells.brief: Pale frozen undead warrior, ice-crusted skin and cracked blue ice armor, cold mist around face.

cells.name: Cult Warden
cells.brief: Living masked cult guardian in crimson ceremonial armor holding a broad ward-marked shield.

cells.name: Cult Chanter
cells.brief: Hooded cult priest holding several small candles, chanting mouth visible, warm healing sigils.

cells.name: Stone Golem
cells.brief: Massive blocky stone humanoid with granite fists, moss-filled joints and a teal rune heart.

cells.name: Frost Acolyte
cells.brief: Young pale-robed ice cult mage holding a frost-tipped staff, crystalline snowflake halo.

cells.name: Bone Archer
cells.brief: Gaunt skeleton archer holding a bone bow and pale arrows, ragged hunter cloak.

cells.name: Crystal Construct
cells.brief: Angular humanoid construct made entirely of clear violet quartz facets, no stone body.

cells.name: Glacial Imp
cells.brief: Small icy blue imp with icicle horns, frost-covered wings and a sharp mischievous grin.

cells.name: Cult Seer
cells.brief: Blindfolded crimson-robed cult oracle with a floating golden third eye above the brow.

cells.name: Revenant Thrall
cells.brief: Decayed shambling undead soldier in torn burial cloth, sagging jaw and broken chain.

cells.name: Hollow Shrieker
cells.brief: Elongated spectral humanoid with enormous open screaming mouth, pale stretched face and flowing tattered shroud.

cells.name: Quartz Serpent
cells.brief: Coiled snake with translucent white quartz scales, diamond-shaped head and tiny cold eyes.

cells.name: Frost Warden
cells.brief: Undead armored guard with a thick ice shield, frozen skull and heavy pale-blue plate.

cells.name: Whisper Witch
cells.brief: Gaunt hooded witch with long silver hair, crooked fingers, green whispered spell ribbons.

cells.name: Cursed Knight
cells.brief: Blackened full-plate undead knight, sealed helm, cursed violet cracks and a broken long sword.

cells.name: Voidspawn
cells.brief: Inhuman amorphous violet-black creature with branching tendrils and a single glowing void core.

cells.name: Bone Summoner
cells.brief: Skeletal necromancer in bone-trimmed robes, skull staff, small levitating ribs in one hand.

cells.name: Shadow Assassin
cells.brief: Slender masked humanoid assassin in dark leather with two curved daggers and trailing smoke.

cells.name: Arcane Caster
cells.brief: Tall mystic in indigo robes, face hidden behind a glowing arcane visor, hovering spell orb.

cells.name: Ancient Drake
cells.brief: Ancient green-bronze dragon with long horned head, heavy scales and folded leathery wings.

cells.name: Void Acolyte
cells.brief: Hooded novice void mage with dark violet robes, faint human face and small contained black star.

cells.name: Wraith Lord
cells.brief: Regal spectral lord with a jagged floating crown, long ghostly mantle and purple skeletal face.

cells.name: Sundered Titan
cells.brief: Enormous fractured stone titan with one broken shoulder, deep golden fissures and mountain-like silhouette.

cells.name: Void Stalker
cells.brief: Low predatory four-limbed void beast with elongated limbs, eyeless angular face and violet claw tips.

cells.name: Dread Summoner
cells.brief: Towering deathly necromancer with antler-like bone headdress, dark skull mask and shadow summons.

cells.name: Arcane Warden
cells.brief: Armored magical sentinel with woven turquoise spell shields around its arms and a sealed rune helm.

cells.name: Bone Juggernaut
cells.brief: Huge heavy humanoid assembled from layered ribs, massive bone shoulder plates and thick skeletal fists.

cells.name: Void Seer
cells.brief: Floating faceless oracle draped in purple veils, many small violet eyes surrounding a healing sigil.

cells.name: Gloom Wisp
cells.brief: Dark smoky wisp formed from deep violet vault fog, two turquoise eyes and long trailing vapor.

cells.name: Vault Revenant
cells.brief: Tarnished gold-armored undead vault guard with a coffin-shaped shield and a haunted pale face.

cells.name: Crypt Sentinel
cells.brief: Skeletal crypt guard with a square tomb-stone shield, bronze funerary helmet and a long ceremonial spear.

cells.name: Cave Stalker
cells.brief: Low stalking cave arachnid with matte midnight shell, long hooked legs and a subtle red eye cluster; distinct from quartz spider.

cells.name: Ashborn Raider
cells.brief: Ash-grey goblinoid raider with scorched leather, burning hatchet and ember-orange facial scars.

cells.name: Stone Guardian
cells.brief: Carved temple guardian with smooth rounded sandstone plates, broad shoulders and an ancient gold sigil; distinct from rough golem.

cells.name: The Hollow Sovereign
cells.brief: The Hollow Sovereign: majestic dark fantasy monarch with black horned crown, ivory faceless mask, floating violet armor and eclipsed halo.

cells.name: Skeleton
cells.brief: Unarmored simple skeleton with a clean skull, visible thin rib cage and a small rusty dagger; distinct from armored warrior.

cells.name: Slime
cells.brief: Small luminous jade-green jelly slime with a rounded dome, tiny bubble eyes and translucent droplets; no fire.

cells.name: Boss Cave Bat
cells.brief: A small leathery cave bat, broad membranous wings, large pointed ears, tiny amber eyes; unmistakably a bat. Boss version: visibly grander, a unique ornate crown or head crest, gilded menace and a radiant crimson-gold power aura; same unmistakable creature species.
